name: A2Z Cust2Mate Solutions Corp.
summary: A2Z Cust2Mate Solutions Corp., a technology company, focuses on the development and commercialization of retail smart cart solutions for grocery stores and supermarkets in Israel and internationally. It operates through Precision Metal Parts, Advanced Engineering, and Smart Carts segments. The company provides Cust2Mate system, which incorporates a smart cart that automatically calculates the value of the customers purchases in their smart cart without having to unload and reload their purchases at a customer checkout point.
